acceptance: In pi_rpc_client.rs the field `catalog: Mutex<Catalog>` of `pub struct PiRpcClient` becomes `catalog: Box<Mutex<Catalog>>`, and its construction in `spawn` becomes `Box::new(Mutex::new(Catalog { ... }))` (same Catalog contents). Add this doc comment on the field: `/// Boxed: the client sits inside the SessionClient enum, whose variants must stay size-comparable (clippy::large_enum_variant).` Every `.lock()` use compiles unchanged through auto-deref. No other change

`cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` pass (the large_enum_variant error on SessionClient is gone) and `perl -e 'alarm 600; exec @ARGV' -- cargo nextest run --workspace --no-fail-fast` shows 2584 tests, 0 failures (one known flaky test failing once and passing alone is acceptable; report it). No other file is edited
user_request: Restore the Box around PiRpcClient's catalog that the extraction dropped; clippy::large_enum_variant fires on SessionClient without it.
